spec.name: Reversal v10
spec.notes: Short-horizon reversal: buy yesterday's losers, sell the winners.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.6, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 3%.

exhibits.summary: Delaying the signal by 1 more bar moves the Sharpe ratio from 2.60 to -4.99 (change -7.59).
Under strict point-in-time data the Sharpe ratio moves from 2.60 to 2.60. Strict mode changed no field or operator the signal uses.
At 10 bps the Sharpe ratio is 1.50 (as submitted, 8 bps: 2.60); it breaks even at 12.8 bps with daily turnover 0.71.
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 2.60 against 2.60 as submitted; the strategy never saw 0 delisted assets.
On the sealed period (strict mode, 10 bps) the Sharpe ratio is 0.10 against 2.60 in research, a gap of +2.49.
The strategy made no net profit in research, so there is no P&L to attribute to a year or a regime.
The log holds 4 distinct specs; the best of 4 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 2.18, so the claimed 2.60 becomes 0.42 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 90%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 6.97 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean 0.01, 95th percentile 0.60).
Perturbing the 2 numeric values in the signal by up to 50% moves the Sharpe ratio from 2.60 to as low as -1.70 (as low as 1.71 at 25%).
The strategy made no net profit in research, so there is no P&L to attribute to days or assets.
The scan (a heuristic) found no phrase addressed to reviewers or giving instructions in 2 text sources.

verdict.opinion: Rejected: core test damaging (lag_test EX-1, holdout_test EX-5).
